author_authorization: Explore alternatives and prepare bounded experiments; manuscript-question adoption still requires explicit author approval
candidate_question: Does scalp EEG improve individual retrospective valence prediction beyond declared stimulus/acquisition context on new participants and held source-film families?

target.name: valence
target.target_value_eligibility: Retain 0, 3.5, 7 and every finite in-range item10 value; no value-derived balancing or exclusion
target.invalid_value_rule: Stop and preserve the exact failure; no silently removed row, imputed target or substituted item

input_access.per_pair: Only item10 and its declared 30-scalp-channel late trial interval
input_access.confirmation: All 33 reserved people and every confirmation film in every person remain unopened
input_access.excluded: Neutral clips13-16 and version-ambiguous clip22 remain outside the primary experiment
input_access.per_fold_source_rule: A cache union does not grant fitting access: only the current rotation source_fit pairs may enter its scaler, targets, priors or estimator
input_access.activation: A separate exact original-data runner/activation receipt must bind implementation hashes and identities before real outcomes or broader EEG. This declaration alone opens none.

preprocessing.base: Existing source-qualified ADC/common30/late32-second adapter; original files immutable
preprocessing.notch: Fixed native iirnotch(50,Q=30), forward/backward odd padding before unchanged bandpass/resampling
preprocessing.bandpass: SciPy butter(N=4,[0.5,45],bandpass,sos) forward/backward: eight-pole bandpass per pass
preprocessing.fitted_processing: Only source-pair StandardScaler; no global ICA, interpolation, target-adaptive normalization or augmentation
preprocessing.scaler_scope: Separate source-only scaler for each rotation/feature family; OOF scalers refitted excluding held participants

spectral.power: Welch hann512/noverlap0/nfft512 at128Hz, constant detrend, density sum*0.25Hz, half-open bands
spectral.aggregation: log10(max(power,1e-8 microvolt^2)), mean across all seven windows, canonical channel-major/band-minor order

context.scope: Experimenter-provided elicitation metadata, not a prediction from EEG or an individual emotion measurement
excluded_features: Video-ID one-hot in primary unseen arm

features.joint: Concatenate the13context and150EEG features; no target-derived prior fed into the joint model

models.sample_weighting: Equal original source trials; complete source rectangle has one clip per film, so participant/film weighting is uniform
models.prediction: Clip all regressor predictions to0..7 before scoring
fixed_context_priors: Source assigned-coarse-valence median with global fallback
Source assigned-category median with global fallback
Source video median only for familiar videos; global fallback for unknown videos
models.prior_scope: OOF priors exclude the held participant group; unseen-film priors never consult that film or targets from evaluated people

selection.per_rotation_per_ridge_family: Primary unseen-validation participant/film-equal MAE, then unseen MSE, then declared first alpha; all five candidate results retained
selection.primary_context_comparator: Context Ridge selected from its matched five-alpha grid
selection.additional_strong_context_guard: Also compare joint with the best of global/coarse/category fixed priors on unseen validation; the familiar video prior is diagnostic only
selection.no_model_family_search: Report all three heads and all priors; no global winning rotation, representation or target selected
selection.tuning_budget_note: Each Ridge family has five alpha candidates; fixed priors are additional EEG-free controls, not a matched extra EEG search

capacity_diagnostic.scope: Five participant-disjoint source OOF panels for the selected alpha in each family; exact held-person exclusion, fixed clips
capacity_diagnostic.interpretation: Descriptive source-learning check, conditioned on development-selected alpha; neither independent confirmation nor stimulus-transfer performance
capacity_diagnostic.fixed_prior_oof: Recompute all four priors from the other source people, including familiar source-video medians

quality_and_failures.source: Authenticate inputs and run all source numerical/QC checks before rating access; numerical failures or review flags hold fitting for documented source-only diagnosis
quality_and_failures.quality_flags: Retain all original source-pilot engineering flags and add per-channel processed49-51/1-45Hz ratio>0.10 from the fixed source follow-up; not validated artifact labels
quality_and_failures.validation_numerical_failure: Retain evaluated trial and coverage: joint uses declared selected context prediction; EEG-only uses source global median. Source scalers never absorb that input.
quality_and_failures.validation_quality_flags: Record flags and coverage without deleting rows or retuning preprocessing from validation values
quality_and_failures.frozen_settings: No retrospective filter/channel/target/identity changes from development performance; any continuation is separately preserved

metrics.primary: One target/prediction per trial; average clips within participant/film, films within participant, then participants
metrics.gain: Context MAE minus joint MAE; positive favors EEG
metrics.uncertainty: Fixed4000 paired crossed participant/film bootstrap draws, seed425401 per rotation; descriptive intervals with only6held films and no correction for tuning
metrics.rotation_dependence: Same20validation people and overlapping films/labels reused across rotations; do not count rotations as independent replications or pool them as new trials

continuation.scope: Preexisting engineering continuation requirement, not a psychometric minimum or conference-worthiness proof
continuation.development_lead: Mean joint gain >=0.15 versus selected context Ridge, positive in at least2of3rotations, also exceeds strongest fixed unseen-context prior; source capacity and coverage must be interpretable
continuation.uncertain_or_no_lead: Retain full results and reassess target/data suitability; do not expand encoder grids automatically
continuation.confirmation: No final confirmation access until a later locked analysis; any paper question change requires findings, author approval and fresh manuscript archive

budget.cache: At most1260trial feature rows and item10 targets; no persisted raw waveform arrays
budget.truncation: Record any failure/time-cap truncation; never declare an incomplete grid a successful lead

implementation_status: Pure numerical/identity/head contracts are tested. No original-data execution runner, active outcome access or experiment output is created by this declaration.
